Hi Jane — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the launch. We can support a short-window uplift; quick outline below and I attached an estimate.

Two commercial options we typically offer for microbursts:

1) Provisional uplift (recommended for ~48–72 hours): we provision dedicated headroom for the window. Billing is a blended uplift rate for the provisioned period (lower than overrun surcharge) and we reconcile usage after the window with a prorated true-up. Requires a signed PO for the provisional uplift amount.

2) Ad-hoc overrun true-up (fastest to approve): keep you on your current quota, let usage exceed the threshold, and apply an overrun surcharge to excess tokens. No PO required in advance but surcharge can be material (typically +25–40% over baseline unit price depending on peak).

Operational notes: we can route traffic to a burst pool and keep the same model variant — latency should remain within your SLA if you avoid concurrent very long-context requests. Monica (cc) can follow up with throttling/warm-pool guidance.

Next step — can you confirm:
- expected peak qps (approx)
- window start/end (you mentioned 04/15–04/16 UTC/PDT?)
- whether procurement needs a line-item PO or a single invoice after reconciliation

I've attached a quick estimate (nimbus_trueup_estimate.xlsx) and a short pricing explainer (nimbus_microburst_pricing.pdf). If you want, Ben can propose a blended uplift figure that factors in a small commitment in exchange for a reduced uplift rate.

—Jordan

Jane — looping in a commercial view. Two practical paths with numbers (ballpark; see attached spreadsheet for line items):

A) Provisional uplift (preferred if Nimbus wants predictable spend)
- Provisioned headroom: +300% of current quota for 48 hours
- Blended uplift rate: baseline unit price * 1.12 (12% uplift) for provisioned tokens during window
- Post-window reconciliation: actual usage reconciled; if usage < provision, we credit the difference at blended rate; if usage > provision, excess is invoiced at baseline rate + 10%
- Requires PO for the provisional amount; we can accept electronic PO and issue proforma invoice within 2 hours.

B) Overrun true-up (no advance PO)
- No provisioning; any excess billed at baseline unit price * 1.35 (35% surcharge)
- Invoices after month-end reconciliation

Discount/packaging note: if Nimbus is willing to commit to a short-term uplift as a one-time addendum (e.g., commit to a small extra monthly commit for 3 months), we can reduce the provisional uplift rate to baseline * 1.05. That requires an amendment to the current SOW.

Hi all — ops/infra note:

We can stand up warm workers in the burst pool within ~90 minutes of signoff. A few operational best practices to avoid cold-start latency spikes:
- Pre-warm model instances with representative requests ~30–60 minutes before the window.
- Keep request max length constrained during peak (reduce max tokens where possible).
- If you have long-running streaming responses, stagger them to avoid synchronized KV cache pressure.
- We recommend the provisional uplift path if you need firm latency guarantees.

I'll coordinate the warm pool provisioning once you confirm the window start and the list of callers/IPs (for routing).

—Monica
